pool.notes: Each note is printed only under its own crisis (config.stressTypes); the crisis is declared on the row. "Kept byte-identical to foodGenerator.js's production block" — a second copy of these lines lives there (not in this seat's manifest).

rows.text: Famine: the ${FAILED_SOURCE_WORDS[failed]} failed, taking ${famineCutPct}% of local food p
rows.notes: FAILED_SOURCE_WORDS {grain harvest, herds, fishing, mill, hunt}: each word presumes food-source: <failed>, guaranteed (failedSource = foodSources[0]).

rows.text: Famine: crop failure has reduced local food production to 35% of normal capacity.
rows.notes: Prints when the record names no failed source — "crop" presumes grain.

rows.text: Siege: external supply lines severed and outlying farmland abandoned or razed.
Plague: agricultural workforce decimated by illness, fields understaffed.
Occupation: occupying forces consume approximately 20% of food supply beyond normal needs.
Wartime: conscription has thinned the agricultural workforce, cutting local output.
Slave revolt: labour-dependent production is disrupted and outlying fields lie idle.
Mass migration: an influx of newcomers stresses the food balance beyond normal needs.
rows.notes: Crisis kind mass_migration does not by itself say in/out; the line presumes IN.
